## Scope

- Batch / bounded change:
- User-visible behavior changed:
- Explicitly deferred:

## Contract and safety review

- [ ] Current branch and task file allowlist were verified before editing
- [ ] The final diff contains no unrelated changes or new runtime dependencies
- [ ] Advertised operations, API matrix, detailed coverage, README, and status agree
- [ ] Destructive behavior, partial results, acceptance-versus-delivery, and retry semantics are stated honestly
- [ ] No credentials, customer data, or production payloads appear in code, fixtures, logs, screenshots, or exports

## Evidence

- [ ] Frozen dependency install
- [ ] Format, official lint, strict typecheck, and full Vitest suite
- [ ] Build and official source/built scanner
- [ ] Release and package-boundary checks
- [ ] Workspace constructor/icon load smoke
- [ ] Isolated packed install/load smoke
- [ ] Live API checks recorded, or explicitly skipped with reason
- [ ] Actual n8n editor checks recorded, or explicitly skipped with reason
- [ ] Creator Portal checks recorded when applicable, or explicitly not applicable

## Handoff

- Commands/results:
- Compatibility actually exercised:
- Open issues/blockers:
- Rollback or cleanup notes:
